tools.name: analyze_url
tools.title: Analyze URL for GEO/SEO
tools.description: Run geodaddy GEO/SEO analysis on a URL. Returns a JSON report with overall score (0-100), per-category scores (Technical, Content, GEO, Performance), per-page analysis results, and actionable fix recommendations for AI search engine optimization.

max_pages.description: Enable site crawling, stop after N pages

enable_js.description: Enable JavaScript rendering (downloads Chromium on first use)

vitals.description: Measure Core Web Vitals (LCP, FCP, CLS, TTFB, TBT) via headless browser

fail_under.description: Return error if overall score is below this threshold (0-100)

beauty.description: Return colored human-readable output instead of JSON (note: disables JSON output)
